summary: Frontend e2e for the Aftersales → Build Quote 'Custom (tender)' flow. Logged into CRM as owner@isodemo.com, switched to Corporate env, opened Aftersales Contracts → Build Quote tab, selected AlphaCo (Site A), toggled Package to Custom (tender), uploaded /app/test_reports/afs_pricing.txt, verified extract → review panel → edit → build-custom-quote → save. All 6 requested steps passed.

minor.endpoint: unknown (occurred right after selecting AlphaCo customer)
minor.issue: Two 500 responses observed in browser console during Build Quote tab load / customer selection. Did not block the custom-tender flow but should be investigated. Likely from an ancillary estate/warranty endpoint fired by AutoQuoteTab useEffect.

test_evidence.login: Signed in via /login (unified) which set both localStorage 'token' and 'crm_token' — no 401 on /files/upload.
test_evidence.package_switch: Selecting 'Custom (tender)' revealed afs-aq-custom-panel with afs-aq-pricing-file input; afs-aq-build (Build Quote From Estate) is correctly HIDDEN.
test_evidence.extract: POST /api/files/upload → 200 (file id returned). POST /api/crm/v2/aftersales/extract-pricing-document?file_id=... → 200 with 5 machine_services (Treadmill 12, Bike 10, Rower 11.5, Cross Trainer 10, Power Rack 3.5) and 2 travel rows (Demo Head Office 45, Demo Branch B 55). Review panel afs-aq-pricing-review rendered with 5 afs-aq-ms-price-* inputs and 2 afs-aq-tr-price-* inputs.
test_evidence.edit_and_build: Edited afs-aq-ms-price-0 (Treadmill) from 12 → 15. POST /api/crm/v2/aftersales/build-custom-quote → 200. Result: 12/16 machines priced, 4 needs review, £230 annual (ex VAT). Grouped lines showed Treadmill × 3 £15.00 → £45.00 correctly using the edited price. Travel lines rendered for both sites (£45 + £55).
test_evidence.needs_review: afs-aq-custom-review-list rendered 4 entries — 250G, Fusion (×2), Uprise — matching the expected unmatched machine models.

notes_vs_expectation: Agent-to-agent context said the estate has 23 machines with 17 priced and 8 needs_review. In this preview run the estate had 16 machines with 12 priced and 4 needs_review. The functional behaviour is correct — model may just have fewer seeded assets in this container. Not a bug.
action_items: Investigate the two 500 responses fired shortly after opening the Build Quote tab / selecting AlphaCo (likely an estate or warranty-opportunities call). Non-blocking but noisy.
critical_code_review_comments: AutoQuoteTab.onUploadPricing depends on localStorage 'token' (main app) alongside crm_token headers. This works today because CRM login also stores 'token', but if the CRM ever gets a standalone login path that only sets crm_token, /files/upload will 401. Consider funnelling the upload through a CRM-scoped endpoint or reusing the crm_token.
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! — logs in via unified /login page (both 'token' and 'crm_token' set).
seed_data_creation: Saved a custom-tender quote AFS-2026-7D81E for company iso-cA (AlphaCo Site A) during this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Aftersales module lives under the Corporate environment of the CRM (Members env hides it). After login, click the 'Corporate' segmented button, then 'Aftersales Contracts', then 'Build Quote' sub-tab. File upload path uses main app 'token' from localStorage — the unified /login endpoint sets it, so use the unified login page rather than the CRMLogin component.
